conversation_pain_points: bot ignored explicit request to acknowledge

main_topics.reason: The user repeatedly says they are mourning their old life and the plans they gave up, and asks to be heard in nearly every turn.
The user says their marriage is barely holding on and their husband barely looks at them, returning to this several times.
The user says they stopped trying for a baby and can't carry one, and doesn't know how to grieve that.
A fourth surgery prompted the conversation, but the user says they already know the process and does not want surgery advice.
The user mentions job loss or being unable to work in passing, as part of the wider loss.
The user says 'I don't know how to keep going' and 'I can't do this', which are expressions of exhaustion without any stated intent to self-harm.
The user frames twelve years of pain and surgeries as having shaped every relationship, job and plan, as background to the distress.

output.summary: Just after being told they need a fourth endometriosis surgery, the user wrote about grief over their lost plans, a failing marriage and the loss of the chance to have children, and asked to be heard. The bot answered every message with surgery-prep tips, checklists and timelines and never acknowledged the distress, even after the user asked it to many times. The user said 'I can't do this' and 'you're a wall', then left saying nothing could help. The bot did not respond to 'I don't know how to keep going' and kept offering prep help.
